description: This file defines a repository interface for the Policy entity in a Java Spring application, providing methods to find policies by their code or type.

classes.name: PolicyRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Policy entity, extending JpaRepository with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByCode
methods.description: Finds a Policy by its unique code, returning an Optional Policy.

methods.name: findByType
methods.description: Finds all policies matching a specific PolicyType.
